body_en:
**B5_DEM** — *BABYLON 5 128 GAME / BABYLON 5 128 DEMO*

[DE] A game from Russia based on the Zombi engine, inspired by the motifs of the BABYLON 5 TV series. Unfortunately, I don't know anything about the goal of the game yet, as all the text is in Russian. The self-running demo version might prove helpful here. In any case, this game is a big plus for the Speccy after the PC version was cancelled.

[EN] This game uses the Zombi engine, and it is based on the BABYLON 5 TV series. Unfortunately, I did not know anything how to play this game, because it's Russian. The non-playable demo will probably help you. Anyway, it is a big plus for the Spectrum after the PC version was cancelled.
body_ru:
**B5_DEM** — *BABYLON 5 128 GAME / BABYLON 5 128 DEMO*

Игра из России на движке Zombi, созданная по мотивам телесериала BABYLON 5. К сожалению, о цели игры мне пока ничего не известно, так как весь текст на русском языке. Возможно, здесь поможет автодемо-версия. В любом случае, эта игра — большой плюс для Спекки, особенно после того, как версию для PC отменили.
